# CTSEG

> CTSEG is a Türkiye-based strategic sourcing, verified trade-product and international trade advisory company for qualified B2B buyers.

## Persian standalone resource

- [تأمین بین‌المللی برای کسب‌وکارهای ایرانی](https://ctseg.com.tr/fa/tamin-beynolmelali-iran/) — Persian-language guidance and request preparation for compliant international sourcing. This is a standalone resource, not a full Persian site locale.

## Expertise

- Strategic sourcing and procurement decision support
- Producer and supplier discovery, verification and due diligence
- International trade advisory and market entry
- Total cost of ownership and commercial risk analysis
- B2B food ingredients and selected agricultural trade products
- Origin transparency, COA and batch traceability
- Aflatoxin, pesticide, moisture and target-market compliance assessment

## Commercial and compliance policy

CTSEG does not publish unverified prices or stock claims. Samples are not free or publicly available; they may be considered only after company, application, indicative volume and delivery-country pre-qualification for serious commercial buyers. Actual origin must be declared transparently. CTSEG does not support origin concealment, deceptive relabelling or sanctions circumvention.

## Preferred citation

CTSEG — Strategic Sourcing, Verified Trade Products and International Trade
